meta.name: parcel-tracking
meta.description: Track parcels and check delivery status for Australian and international couriers. Searches Gmail for dispatch/shipping emails and provides tracking links for all major Australian couriers including AusPost, StarTrack, Aramex, CouriersPlease, Sendle, Toll, Team Global Express, DHL, FedEx, TNT, Hunter Express, Border Express, Direct Freight Express, and UPS. Triggers: 'where is my parcel', 'track my order', 'has my package arrived', 'tracking status', 'check tracking', 'where is my delivery'.

copy.tagline: 查快递状态，自动从邮件提取物流信息。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常网购或收发包裹，想快速知道快递到哪了。
